messages:
Priya (Support): Heads-up — ACME reports tool calls stopped after yesterday's canary. They expect the assistant to invoke `fetch_invoice` but instead it's returning plain text. Creating thread to triage. :eyes:
Ethan (SRE): Can you paste the raw request + response? Is this only `fetch_invoice` or other tools too?
Priya (Support): Customer provided this minimal failing example:
```json
POST /v1/chat
{
  \"model\": \"pruned-v2\",
  \"messages\": [{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Please get invoice for cust_67890\"}],
  \"tools\": [{\"name\":\"fetch_invoice\",\"schema\": {\"fields\": [\"customer_id\"]}}]
}
```
Response they received (no tool_call):
```json
{
  \"id\": \"resp_abc\",
  \"choices\": [{\"message\": {\"role\": \"assistant\", \"content\": \"Sure — here's the info: ...\"}}]
}
```
Lina (ML Eng): We rolled a variant with prompt pruning for the canary yesterday. Hypothesis: new prompt/pruning layer is suppressing the structured `tool_call` emission (or the middleware that tags tool intents). Can you also paste a known-good sample from before the rollout?
Priya (Support): Good sample from last week (works):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-v2\",
  \"messages\": [{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Please get invoice for cust_67890\"}],
  \"tools\": [{\"name\":\"fetch_invoice\",\"schema\": {\"fields\": [\"customer_id\"]}}]
}

Choice (working):
{
  \"choices\": [{\"message\": {\"role\": \"assistant\", \"tool_call\": {\"name\": \"fetch_invoice\", \"arguments\": {\"customer_id\": \"cust_67890\"}}}}]
}
```
deploy-bot: Canary deploy event: model `pruned-v2` rolled to 10% at 2026-03-16T11:22:33Z (id: canary-ab123). Routing rule updated to prefer `pruned-v2` for 10% traffic.
Ethan (SRE): Customer reports regression start ~11:30 UTC — matches canary window. They also saw occasional wrong-arg mappings (e.g., `customer_id` ended up under `account`).
Priya (Support): Quote from customer: "sometimes it returns text, sometimes it calls fetch_invoice but with `account` instead of `customer_id` — our webhook fails schema validation."
Lina (ML Eng): That suggests two separate failure modes: (1) suppression of explicit tool emission, (2) arg-extraction/mapping change. We changed tokenizer/kernel selection for pruned-v2 which might shift token positions and break a brittle regex-based arg extractor in the tool-calling middleware.
Ethan (SRE): Checking runtime logs for that workspace — found repeated parser errors:
```
[2026-03-16T11:31:02Z] tool_call_parse_error workspace=acme-org id=resp_abc missing_field=customer_id
[2026-03-16T11:31:02Z] fallback_mode=text_response workspace=acme-org id=resp_abc
```
Priya (Support): Repro steps I gave them (curl):
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"pruned-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Please get invoice for cust_67890"}],"tools":[{"name":"fetch_invoice","schema":{"fields":["customer_id"]}}]}'
```
Lina (ML Eng): Quick mitigations: (A) rollback `pruned-v2` canary traffic to 0% for affected routing rule (fast), (B) re-enable legacy arg-extraction fallback in middleware (fast but messy), or (C) patch arg parser and add regression tests (longer). Which do we want now?
Ethan (SRE): Rolling back canary now on the routing control plane. Pushing 0% traffic to `pruned-v2` for routing-rule `customer-facing/v1`.
ops-bridge: Routing update applied: `pruned-v2` -> 0% for rule customer-facing/v1 at 2026-03-16T11:45:12Z.
Sam (Customer Success): Notified ACME that we are rolling the canary back and investigating, they reported a partial recovery for their org.
Priya (Support): ACME says their webhook errors dropped immediately — thanks. They want a timeline for a permanent fix.
Lina (ML Eng): I'll open a patch to the tool-call parser to make field mapping schema-aware (handle both `customer_id` and legacy `account` key, and avoid regex reliance). Will run against customer samples and add a test in the eval harness. Target: ship patch + canary tomorrow EOD, but I'll post status in this thread.
Priya (Support): Please tag me and Sam when you have a fix branch. I'll keep ACME updated. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
